title: How a Space Heater Works in 60 Seconds 🔥🏠 #shorts
description:
A space heater turns almost every watt of electricity into heat. Current is forced through a thin coil of nichrome wire, its resistance makes the wire glow hot, and a fan or rising air carries that warmth into the room while a thermostat and tip-over switch keep it safe. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#spaceheater #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A space heater turns almost *100%* of its electricity into heat.

steps.label: Wire
steps.text: Inside is a thin coil of *nichrome* wire, a metal that fights the flow of current.

steps.label: Resistance
steps.text: Electrons push through that *resistance* and bump into atoms, so the wire glows *red hot*.

steps.label: Fan
steps.text: A *fan* blows air across the hot coil and pushes the warmth into the room.

steps.label: Thermostat
steps.text: A *thermostat* switches the coil off when the room is warm enough.

steps.label: Safety
steps.text: If it falls over, a *tip-over switch* cuts the power instantly.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Current, resistance, *heat*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
